metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the winter list, the two leaves, and the word from Hewlands.

yesterday: The shoe stayed off through the morning. The work was the winter list.
Salt is two lines. Light is three. Malt for the house is two bushels. The four is struck.
The old field-name has its middle letter back. Joan's name is on the soap, because the house boils it.
Two leaves were done by ten. Tomorrow the sickles start at six. The old shoes will go on in the morning, and Quiney and Sturley are at the table at half past six.
